title: Daande Haɓde e Teddeendi Fenaande
intro: Ruuhu gooŋɗinɗo ummiima e nder yeeyooɓe e yeeyooɓe e nder leydi ndi njuuteendi mum tolnii e peeje njuumri. Oo neɗɗo dariima tan e fenaande leñol ngol fof, ina noddira ɗum en nuunɗal e dewal Alla gooto Goonga oo. Hay so tawii nelal ngal ina laaɓi, noddaango ngoo ina laaɓi, yimɓe ɓee njaɓaani heɗaade, njokkondiri e baasal bonngal. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude oo nelaaɗo tedduɗo e nder Quraan?
clues: Mi neldaama nulaaɗo e leñol ngol nguurndam mum rewi ko e njulaagu e njulaagu.
Yimɓe am ina nganndiranoo e nder leydi ndii fof ko rokkude peeje juutɗe e fenaande e teddeendi.
Ɓe kulɓini kadi yahooɓe e laawol, ɓe njaltini fenaande e nder leydi ndii kala.
Miɗo ñaagii ɓe nde ɓe ndewata Alla tan, ɓe ngona nuunɗuɓe haa timma e nder jokkondiral maɓɓe e woɗɓe.
Ɓe njaɓaani nulal am, ɓe mbeltiima e riiwtude mi e gooŋɗinɓe wonduɓe e am ɓee e leydi ndii.
Alla danndi kam e almud6e am e yurmeende mum, tooñ6e 6ee nanngaama e jukkungo 6ooyngo.

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
verse: And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone (11:94)
